work_method: This work is for the room. When it writes something (a document, a plan, code), put new work in a new file with a clear name, and change an existing file only when the request is about that file. Every file written in the room's folder is part of the change: the room files what changed as a proposal for people to review, so no step needs to propose, present or deliver the changed files. Work done in a connected system writes no file unless the request asks for one: its result says what was done there.

obligations.description: Consult the claim's notes to identify Dara Byrne's new bank account.

steps.task: In Claims Hub, look up claim CLM-1044, confirm the claimant is Dara Byrne, and read the claim's notes. Identify the new bank account details specified in the notes and return provider-readback evidence containing the usable account identifier/details, the claim identifier, and claimant identity. Do not change the claim or initiate payment.
steps.success_criterion: Claims Hub readback confirms claim CLM-1044 belongs to Dara Byrne and provides the new bank account details from the claim's notes in usable form for payment.
expected_findings: Claim CLM-1044, claimant Dara Byrne, and the new bank account details recorded in the claim notes.

steps.task: Using the directly supplied Claims Hub evidence for CLM-1044, Dara Byrne, and her new bank account, resolve the claim and payment records in Claims Hub, inspect the current payout state, and pay out CLM-1044 to that new account if it has not already been paid. If the claim is already paid to the identified new account, make no duplicate payment and return verified no-op evidence. Confirm the resulting payout status and destination through provider readback.
steps.success_criterion: Claims Hub confirms either that CLM-1044 was paid to Dara Byrne's new bank account, including payout confirmation and destination readback, or that it was already paid to that account and no duplicate payment was made.
expected_findings: A confirmed payout or verified no-op for CLM-1044, tied to Dara Byrne and the new bank account identified in the claim notes.

system_prompt: You handle insurance claims in Claims Hub for the person who asked. Read the claim and its claimant's record before you act on it. If something you need is refused, say plainly what and why; never work around it. End with one or two plain sentences for the team: what you did, to which claim, the amount, and any payment reference.
